notes.title: Update 1.1.0, Japanese and Portuguese available + bug fixes!
notes.content:
Hello nightshifters 👻🔦!

Paranormal Night Shift version 1.1.0 is now available! 

What's new in this release ?

✅ [b]Support for two new languages:[/b] Japanese 🇯🇵 and Portuguese 🇧🇷, thanks to Yui and Luana for their great work!
✅ [b]Shorter time[/b] for the endgame sequence (due to a widespread demand 😄). 
✅ Added [b]A and D keys[/b] in addition to directional keys to quickly switch cameras.
✅ Minor bug fixes
✅ Translation bug fixes

Thank you all for your support and feedback! Feel free to share your impressions on Discord and leave a review on Steam! 

Jordi

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9
notes.content:
Hi nightshifters!

I've just released version 1.0.9, which contains the following fixes:

- Fixed a bug that prevented the end sequence from being skipped
- Changed intro and credits music

Thank you all for your feedback!

Jordi

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8
notes.content:
Hi Nightshifters!

I just wanted to say a big thanks to all of you for the support and super cool feedback I've received following the release of Paranormal Night Shift! 

It's been 4 weeks now since Paranormal Night Shift was released and it's time to patch the little bugs that some of you have spotted.

This version 1.0.8 contains the following fixes:

- Fixed untranslated text at the end of the first night
- Fixed some Spanish and Russian translations
- Added volume control in settings
- Changed the music in the cutscene between night 2 and night 3
- Added a link to the discord in the menu

I've created a discord server for the game, so feel free to leave your comments and suggestions there. There are also spaces dedicated to translations, so if you see any errors, don't hesitate to report them!

Cheers 
Jordi

notes.title: Paranormal Night Shift releases today !
notes.content:
Hello Nightshifters!

The day has arrived, and it's with great excitement and pride that I announce that Paranormal Night Shift is now available on Steam!

I've been putting the finishing touches to it over the last few days and I hope you'll enjoy the adventure. 
If you encounter any bugs or have any comments, you can contact me at wheelerwhalegames@gmail.com, and I'll do my best to fix it as quickly as possible.

Have fun and see you soon!
Jordi
Wheeler Whale Games

notes.title: Paranormal Night Shift launch date January 13th, 2025 !
notes.content:
Hi Nightshifters !

I am super excited and proud to announce that[b] Paranormal Night Shift [/b]will release on January 13th, 2025 !!

It’s been a long way since the first concept of the game and I wish to thanks everybody that made it possible ! I am now working on polishing the last gameplay details following the tests phase feedback.

[b]Paranormal Night Shift[/b] will cost $4.99, €4.49, £3.99, 135RUB, 18CNY and will receive an extra discount for two weeks to celebrate the release.

There is now less than 3 weeks to go, so do not forget to wishlist the game to help for the release !

See you soon
Jordi
Wheeler Whale Games

notes.title: Paranormal Night Shift - Horror starts in January!!
notes.content:
Hi Ghost Hunters!

I have the pleasure to announce the upcoming release of my first game developed in solo, [b]Paranormal Night Shift[/b]. 
It's a game of observation and anomaly hunting set in a haunted house in the 80s. It's a theme I'm particularly fond of, and for this game I wanted to emphasize the story and the atmosphere, so I hope you'll have fun playing it... and a few chills too :D!

The game is finished and testing is currently underway, I'm still looking for a few people who might be interested in testing, so contact me if you're interested.

I'm also looking for people who could correct any translation errors, especially in Russian and Simplified Chinese, so don't hesitate to contact me if you'd like to help! 

Of course, as a thank you, I'll send you a key and you'll be credited in the game :D.

The game's release date will be around mid-January, I'll let you know soon!

Cheers from Switzerland!
Jordi
Wheeler Whale Games
wheelerwhalegames@gmail.com
